summary: F07 and F08 are implemented in src/ui/timing.rs: the selected mode segment is a solid mode-accent chip with white bold text, and both sliders share one geometry (12px rail rounded to 6, constant 16px thumb) with the mixer no longer resizing its handle on hover or drag.

TIMING-MODE-SELECTOR-ACTIVE-STYLE.evidence: mode_selector fills the selected segment with mode_color(mode) (Immediate, Press Delay, Random Mix, Release Delay) and renders its label in Color32::WHITE with the strong weight, dropping the old SURFACE fill with the 1px BORDER stroke; the new widget test test_mode_selector_active_segment_takes_the_mode_accent renders each mode active and asserts a solid accent chip of at least the padded segment height, a white active label, and MUTED_TEXT for the other three.

TIMING-SLIDER-DIMENSIONS-UNIFIED.evidence: Both range_slider and mixer_slider paint with the shared RAIL_WIDTH 12.0 / RAIL_RADIUS 6 / THUMB_RADIUS 8.0 constants; the mixer no longer consumes the theme accent_slider tokens and its handle no longer uses the 7-to-8 hover/drag swell. The new test test_sliders_share_one_geometry asserts the duration rail's (height, radius) equals the mixer rail's, that both duration thumbs and the mixer handle have radius 8.0, and that hover and drag leave the mixer handle at 8.0; test_mixer_rail_splits_primary_left_release_right and test_duration_rail_uses_the_range_geometry now assert the shared dimensions.

risks: The assigned base_commit ab4c4cc is not an ancestor of this branch (the integration line and this worker branch diverge after edde0ce, matching the other worker branches); src/ui/timing.rs at the branch tip is byte-identical to src/ui/timing.rs at ab4c4cc, and the diff of this commit against ab4c4cc is exactly the commit's change, so the owned file applies cleanly to the assigned base.

theme.rs's SLIDER_RAIL_WIDTH, SLIDER_RAIL_RADIUS, SLIDER_HANDLE_RADIUS, and SLIDER_HANDLE_RADIUS_DRAG are now unconsumed by the timing card; retiring them would require theme.rs ownership, which this task does not include.
Native on-screen validation was not performed: the acceptance evidence is widget-level painted-shape, geometry, and text-colour assertions, not a desktop screenshot.
